The Project has two distinct components: 1) The redesign and update to the two websites rwah2o.org and sgah2o.org, and 2) Updating the web content to support ADA Compliance under the new state-mandated laws. Website Redesign and ADA Compliance Project RFP (pdf) Sample Services Agreement (pdf) To be considered, one electronic version of the submittal (send via email) must be received by the principal contact listed below by 3:00 p.m. PT on September 15, 2026 . The RWA and SGA reserve the right to reject any or all submittals after the deadline. Questions regarding the RFP shall be directed to the RWA Project Manager, Ashley Flores, by e-mail to aflores@rwah2o.org Thank you for your interest and efforts in providing the RWA/SGA with the services outlined in the RFP. cases.page_text: RFP: Website Design And Development | Capitalize Albany Search Search User Password Submit Login Search Social Media Facebook Twitter About Contact Membership News & Events Albany Overview Doing Business Partners Downtown Residential Downtown Residential Impact Downtown Albany RFP: Website Design And Development August 17, 2026 Capitalize Albany Corporation is seeking proposals from qualified, creative and experienced firms and professionals to provide website design and development services in designing and launching its new website. Please find a Request For Proposals at the link below. Responses to this RFP are due to Corporation staff by 4 p.m. on Sept. 24 and the successful Respondent to this RFP would be expected to begin work in 2027. RFP: Website Design And Development For Capitalize Albany Corporation As the City of Albany’s economic development organization, for more than four decades the work of Capitalize Albany has elevated New York’s capital city and Capital Region. Our team recognizes the importance of having a website that provides effective engagement as a communications channel, news and information source, form of contact and home for important Corporation-related public documents. To continue to build on Capitalize Albany’s communication strategy, the Corporation wants to redesign the website to incorporate new website technologies with simple navigation. The Corporation requires this website to be highly attractive, modern, functional, mobile friendly, accessible, and responsive. From an administrative perspective, the site must be easy to update by users of varied technical expertise. The current site was launched in 2011. For any and all inquiries related to this RFP please contact Communications Manager Michael Bohne at [email protected] using the subject line Capitalize Albany Website Design RFP. #DowntownWorks Albany's All Business Back To Business Business Development Downtown Residential Employment Featured Topics Impact Downtown Albany News Real Estate Development Uncategorized Photos Videos Broadway Dove Street Downtown Next Photo Next Photo Next Photo Next Photo Next Photo Next Photo Next Photo Next Photo Next Photo Lunch Time in Albany State Street Phone (518) 434-2532 Contact Us Privacy Sitemap Public Docs © 2026 Capitalize Albany Corporation. cases.page_text: Request for Proposals: Contract Content Writer & Storytelling Strategist - MEOPAR --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> Skip to main content Home EN EN FR search Menu Home About About Us Governance Research Themes Research Cores Member Institutions Key Documents & Policies Job opportunities – MEOPAR MEOPAR Logos MEOPAR Merch Research Calls for Proposals Expedition Fund Research Projects MEOPAR Early Career Faculty Tracer Release Experiment Project Fathom Fund Training Opportunities Science Art Showcase Webinars Partnerships Calls for Partnerships Canadian Integrated Ocean Observing System CIOOS Modular Ocean Research Infrastructure (MORI) National Research Vessel Task Team Knowledge Mobilization MEOPAR’s CoP Symposium Communities of Practice National Forum on Coastal Community Resilience MEOPAR’s Ocean Decade Activities MEOPeer Science Videos How to make a research video News Stories Contact Join Our Network EN EN FR search Press enter to begin your search Search Close Search News Request for Proposals: Contract Content Writer & Storytelling Strategist By Odette July 27, 2026 July 29th, 2026 No Comments Request for Proposals (RFP) Contract Content Writer & Storytelling Strategist MEOPAR is seeking proposals from experienced freelance writers to support its communications through the creation of compelling written content and the strategic distribution of its stories. MEOPAR currently publishes content on its website, social media channels, and newsletter, and is looking to expand its reach to new audiences and platforms. The successful contractor will not only produce high quality written content but also bring strategic thinking about where and how MEOPAR’s stories should be shared to maximize reach, relevance, and impact. This is a part-time, remote contract engagement expected to run for six months, with the possibility of extension based on fit and performance. Scope of work includes: Writing two original long-form articles per month, developed through interviews, light research, and collaboration with MEOPAR staff and researchers Repurposing each article into shorter formats, including website news summaries, social media copy, and newsletter teasers Identifying and recommending new pathways for content distribution, such as partner newsletters, external blogs, and industry publications Providing brief, actionable monthly recommendations on content reach and audience growth Supporting a limited amount of ad hoc writing as needed MEOPAR is committed to strengthening Canada’s ocean research, resilience, and innovation by connecting people, science, and data. This contract supports MEOPAR’s broader communications evolution, including a current website refresh, and this role should help bring that strategy to life through clear, engaging, and well distributed storytelling. Please refer to the Request for Proposals document for more information. ( English / French ) Proposals must be submitted by August 17th, 2026. For any questions regarding the RFP, please contact communications@meopar.ca .
